250281101.text: Bah. This record isn't anything special, either. Not an element of pop present, not even a "snap"!

250281102.text: Well, it wasn't right anyway, taking the record without consent. You should return it.

250281103.text: Seriously? You really have gone all soft and sentimental after working with that guy from Liyue.

250281104.text: Besides, these don't sell anyway, so aren't I helping him up his sales count?

250281105.text: Hah! The baby Saurians are enjoying it, though! Just look at 'em.

250281106.text: Enough. Give me the record. I'll return it myself.

250281107.text: ...You done yet? Or do you wanna fight?

250281108.text: Just in time — My muscles could do with some stretching! Haven't had anything to use as practice lately, y'know?

250280201.text: Alright, Lillo. See those fellows there? They're our target for the day. Ready?

250280205.text: Hey there. Fancy running into you! And yes, we are putting the materials together for the new song.

250280206.text: After the previous incident, I talked over a few issues regarding the record with Lillo. Got some ideas from that, too.

250280207.text: You exaggerate. I merely suggested that you change methodologies, or find other materials with which to compose your music.

250280208.text: Some of the music I've heard back in the tribe even incorporates the sound of clashing weapons, the cries of battle, and the sounds of running footsteps.

250280209.text: Songs made like that are very popular, and they spread fast... I think that's what you mean, Mr. Milu Nui, when you talk about "pop."

250280210.text: Precisely! That's why we've been seeking warriors out to see how they fight.

250280211.text: So, have you two found your source of inspiration?

250280212.text: Yes indeed! It's none other than those people up ahead. We heard from the tribe that they've been seeking opponents out here, and that they're pretty tough customers...

250280213.text: Ahem. Simply put, this bunch is always causing trouble outside. They just go up to people on the road and ask them if they want to spar.

250280214.text: And if you lose, you'll be forced to give them something, as the stakes of the match.

250280215.text: Some of my musician friends have been robbed by them too... Such scoundrels!

250280216.text: Indeed, the tribespeople have had it up to here with their nonsense. They want someone to teach them a lesson.

250280217.text: Sure sounds like a pretty strange bunch...

250280218.text: Ah, who knows what's going through their heads? To be honest, I've never understood how people like them think.

250280219.text: If you're willing, go teach them a lesson alongside Lillo, would you?

250280220.text: I've witnessed your skills before. Another demonstration will prove to be a great inspiration, I'm sure of it!

250280221.text: But please! If you see that they have any record with them, be sure not to damage it!

250280222.text: Otherwise, my musician friends would faint again, right on the spot...

subQuests.subQuestName: Teach those troublemaking tribespeople a lesson

250280801.text: Did you manage to get my record back?

250280802.text: Why did they snatch it, anyway?

250280803.text: This... Well, it's a long story. I had just come up with a brand-new song. It sings of Spring, animals, and some other things...

250280804.text: But after listening to it, that rascal Pakaa just dumped it straight into the children's section!

250280805.text: He even had the nerve — the nerve! — to tell me how children and baby Saurians alike would adore such interesting, pithy tunes...

250280806.text: Argh, dammit! I'm making real pop music over here! Not kids' songs!

250280807.text: I was so beside myself with fury that I brought my record here, hoping to enjoy the music I'd made myself.

250280808.text: But as I listened, a group of little Koholasaurs came crowding over.

250280809.text: And before I knew it, they came charging in, snatched the record up with their teeth, and made off with it!

250280810.text: I planned to give chase, but before I'd gone far, I discovered a gathering of people... and an angry lot they were, too!

250280811.text: They might've been the ones who, coveting the music I'd made, directed the Koholasaurs to snag my record.

250280812.text: And, and... Aaargh! I've had it with this! Please, good adventurer. I, Milu Nui, am begging you — please, help me get my record back!

250280813.text: I—If you can... Please, try to keep my record as intact as you can. If not... My hard work over the last few days... It will all be in vain...

250280401.text: A brilliant battle, you two! I must say, you left quite the impression!

250280402.text: Not only were you strong, but rhythmic. Why, you commanded that battle as a conductor would, baton in hand!

250280403.text: Most importantly... The record is pretty much intact! Thanks to you, my friends can finally have a good night's sleep.

250280404.text: Hmm... Wait, rhythm...? That's right! That's it! This is the rhythm I'm looking for!

250280405.text: We could use it as the basis of the melody... No, I'll need an instrument with a lower sound profile...

250280406.text: Anyway, these are for you, so please, take them! Come on, Lillo, let's head back to the tribe. I've got the inspiration I need!

250280407.text: Agh, I shall have to write down all these rhythms, but where do I... Right, my clothes! I'll just pen 'em down here!

250280101.text: Oh no, oh no! My pop music masterpiece is about to be consumed! Devoured!

250280102.text: Had I known this would happen, I'd have asked — no, begged — Pakaa to put it in the children's section...

250280105.text: I have a commission for you — one of utmost importance! Natlan's... no, the future of pop music the world over is in your hands! Please, you must rescue it!

250280109.text: Please, save my record! If not, it shall be eaten by those little Koholasaurs... or wrecked by those tone-deaf thugs!

250280108.text: Huh? Um... Well... I'm glad you have the talent, and we could certainly work together in the future. But for now...

250280301.text: Ah... Looks like these boxes were broken... and the record atop them was...

250280302.text: He must be leading us over that way. *sigh* Where did he learn all this nonsense from?

250280303.text: You're the ones Mr. Milu Nui asked to pick up the record, right? I've seen you talking to him, so I can guess your purpose.

250280304.text: We're all People of the Springs. That guy... He used to be an alright sort. No clue where he's been getting all these bad habits lately.

250280305.text: Ah yes, I forgot to introduce myself. You can call me Lillo — and again, I apologize for my... compatriot's behavior.

250280306.text: ...Bah. I'm no good at formal conversation. If we were back with the tribe, I'd have treated you to a drink of water at least.

250280308.text: Huh, that so? ...Y'know what, judging by your appearance, and how you acquitted yourself back there, you do seem to be an experienced adventurer.

250280313.text: ...Anyway. Never mind that for now. Let's clean this place up first. I'll collect the fragments of the record.

250280314.text: Then I'll go with you to see Mr. Milu Nui. I must apologize to him in person.

250280310.text: That's right. I was once hired by a gentleman from Liyue. Accompanied him into the mountains to prospect for ore veins.

250280311.text: I learned a lot from working with him — and when he left, he even gave me a name in his nation's style, "Yiyang."

250280312.text: According to him, it means "to soar elegantly in the air." Not that I really understand where he got that, though...

250280602.text: He must've been trying to lead us that way. Good thing you're so skilled.

250280603.text: You're the ones Mr. Milu Nui asked to pick up the record, right? I've seen you talking to him, so I can guess your purpose.

250280604.text: We're all People of the Springs. That guy... He used to be an alright sort. No clue where he's been getting all these bad habits lately.

250280605.text: Ah yes, I forgot to introduce myself. You can call me Lillo — and again, I apologize for my... compatriot's behavior.

250280606.text: ...Bah. I'm no good at formal conversation. If we were back with the tribe, I'd have treated you to a drink of water at least.

250280608.text: Huh, that so? ...Y'know what, judging by your appearance, and how you acquitted yourself back there, you do seem to be an experienced adventurer.

250280613.text: Anyway, never mind that. Let's clean our surroundings up. I'll pack the record so it doesn't get damaged again...

250280614.text: Then I'll go with you to see Mr. Milu Nui. I must apologize to him in person.

250280610.text: That's right. I was once hired by a gentleman from Liyue. Accompanied him into the mountains to prospect for ore veins.

250280611.text: I learned a lot from working with him — and when he left, he even gave me a name in his nation's style, "Yiyang."

250280612.text: According to him, it means "to soar elegantly in the air." Not that I really understand where he got that, though...

250280501.text: Ah, my record! Thank goodness, it's undamaged...

250280502.text: I must apologize, Mr Milu Nui. My companion was the one who stole the record. Please accept my apologies on his behalf.

250280503.text: The record is fine, and that's what matters.

250280504.text: Right you are, right you are indeed. This one was the original record, too... Had it been damaged, I'd have found the nearest cliff to leap off of.

250280505.text: ...And Lillo, brother, don't hang your head. The record's fine, so there's no point being petty about all this.

250280506.text: Just answer one of my questions, and we'll call us even.

250280507.text: Ask away. I will give you my best answer.

250280508.text: When you were listening to my record, did you think it was good?

250280509.text: Not the "it'll be a hit amongst children and baby Saurians" sort of "good," but rather... in the "pop" sense, of having that pop spirit!

250280510.text: Do you get what I mean? Did you get that feeling when listening to it?

250280511.text: "Pop"? Well... Give me a moment, please...

250280512.text: I mean, you must've sent the baby Saurians to snatch the record because of the deep spirit of pop within the music, didn't you?

250280513.text: Hang on, please let me explain...

250280514.text: We... never "ordered" the baby Saurians to snatch your record...

250280515.text: They were drawn to your song of their own accord...

250280517.text: I mean to say that your songs are outstanding! Believe you me, the baby Saurians crowd around and run about every time I play your music. Never seen them happier!

250280519.text: I know how you feel, having such a precious thing threatened like that...

250280520.text: But look, I'm willing to work as your bodyguard for free, at least until you've released a new record. No one's stealing anything from you as long as I'm around — I guarantee it!

250280521.text: Agh! My records aren't children's songs!

250280701.text: Ah... My record... It was the original... The original!

250280702.text: I'm very sorry. If there's anything I can do for you, please let me know...

250280705.text: Ah, forget it. And there's no way to restore something this shattered...

250280706.text: Now that it's come to this, I just want to ask you a question...

250280707.text: ...When you were listening to my record, did you think it was good?

250280708.text: Not the "it'll be a hit amongst children and baby Saurians" sort of "good," but rather... in the "pop" sense, of having that pop spirit!

250280709.text: Do you get what I mean? Did you get that feeling when listening to it?

250280710.text: "Pop"? Well... Give me a moment, please...

250280711.text: I mean, you must've sent the baby Saurians to snatch the record because of the deep spirit of pop within the music, didn't you?

250280712.text: Hang on, please let me explain...

250280713.text: We... never "ordered" the baby Saurians to snatch your record...

250280714.text: They were drawn to your song of their own accord...

250280716.text: I mean to say that your songs are outstanding! Believe you me, the baby Saurians crowd around and run about every time I play your music. Never seen them happier!

250280718.text: I know how you feel, and I'm very sorry that such an excellent record was destroyed... Look, I'll help you record a new one! No one's stealing anything from you as long as I'm around — I guarantee it!

250280719.text: Agh! My records aren't children's songs!

250281001.text: What exactly makes music "pop," exactly? This is so hard...

250281201.text: A brilliant battle, you two! I must say, you left quite the impression!

250281202.text: Not only were you strong, but rhythmic. Why, you commanded that battle as a conductor would, baton in hand! But...

250281203.text: ...Alas, the record has been utterly shattered — a dissonant note in an otherwise fabulous performance.

250281204.text: May the Wayob protect those unfortunate friends of mine... But if nothing else, I can bring some of the record back to them.

250281205.text: Anyway, these are for you, so please, take them! Come on, Lillo, let's head back to the tribe.

250281206.text: *sigh* And with any luck, there won't be any fainting from my friends...

250281301.text: Alright, Lillo. See those fellows there? They're our target for the day. Ready?

250281303.text: How are things going with your record?

250281304.text: #My oh my, if it isn't {NICKNAME}? Well, my record's almost ready — thanks to you, Lillo, and those musician friends of mine.

250281305.text: This record combines the sounds of battle, shouts, and all manner of nature sounds... Truly a unique record!

250281306.text: And we also managed to help our musician friends retrieve some of those involuntarily "borrowed" records in the process.

250281307.text: All in all, I'd say that it's all gone rather smoothly thus far, and we've got a good thing going here.

250281308.text: #Ah, yes. We were just about to retrieve another unreturned "borrowed" recording. If you're willing, {NICKNAME}, would you lend us a hand?

250281310.text: Thank you! Once I finish this record, I'll make sure your name's first on the acknowledgments list!

250281313.text: And as for you, Lillo... Would the second slot work?

250281314.text: #It would be my honor. Come, {NICKNAME}. Let us go.

250281312.text: Why of course! Indeed, once I finish this record, I'll make sure your name's first on the acknowledgments list!

250289901.text: ...Put that record down. You might not have any etiquette, but show some respect for music, at least!

250289902.text: Oh no! The record's been broken too!

250289903.text: Hahaha! Someone new to test myself against, nice!
